Hi Tom,

Thanks again for joining the discovery call this morning. Quick recap so we have the same page and a proposed path forward: 

Highlights from today
- Primary goal: embed search and personalized recommendations into the checkout flow with sub-200ms tail latency.
- Data sensitivity: POI / user behavior is regulated for a subset of customers — you called out that a VPC/private deployment is preferred for compliance.
- Traffic profile: steady 10 QPS with 20% spiky burst during sales.

What I suggested
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) deployed into your AWS VPC via Private Connect. This gives predictable throughput + customer-managed network controls.
- Optional on-prem bundle if you require air-gapped processing for specific SKUs.

Attachments I shared
- redwood-dedicated-quote.pdf (draft pricing + SOW)
- ava-vpc-requirements.xlsx (simple checklist for network & firewall rules)

Proposed next steps
1) Confirm VPC vs on-prem preference and target timeline (pilot vs production).
2) Identify technical contact for a 30-min deep-dive (networking + auth + expected token sizing).
3) We’ll provide an updated quote and an estimated rollout plan once we have the network requirements.
